resources.string: Lets RemoteMan relay taps and swipes from the helper device to this one during an active, user-approved session only.
Needed to show the floating control bar during a session.

Lets a connected helper tap, swipe and type on this device. Only active during a session you approve. If the toggle looks greyed out, open App info for RemoteMan, tap the ⋮ menu, choose "Allow restricted settings", then come back here.
Shows an ongoing notification while a session is live.
Lets a connected helper see this screen. Asked for again at the start of each session.
Some phones (Realme, Vivo, Xiaomi and similar) kill apps in the background by default, which can cut a session early. Turning this on stops that for RemoteMan.

Hosting a help server gives whoever enters your code full view and control of this device: every tap, every screen, every app. Only share the code with someone you trust, and only while you are watching. Stopping the server ends their access immediately.
Clears cache and restarts RemoteMan fresh, like a reinstall.
Immediately ends any active session and kills the app completely.
